# goslop text fixture — retry-loop handler: the failure feeds the retry
# machinery and the loop continues (niquests sgi/__init__.py:129 FP shape)
lang: python
file: retry_loop.py
---
def send(request):
    retries = Retry(total=3)
    while True:
        try:
            return do_send(request)
        except Exception as err:
            try:
                retries = retries.increment(request.url, error=err)
            except MaxRetryError:
                raise
            retries.sleep()
            continue
